ouroboros.contracts.v1.AskResponse.jsons.description: AskResponse returns exactly one grounded result or non-disclosing denial.

error.description: error uses the same static model for absent, denied, and revoked reads.

receipt.description: receipt records the authorized query decision.

success.description: success contains the grounded result after authorization.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.AskResponse.jsons.title: Ask Response

ouroboros.contracts.v1.AskSuccess.jsonsc.description: AskSuccess contains one grounded result with freshness and coverage disclosure.

answer.description: answer is the bounded answered, partial, or abstained result.

coverage.description: coverage discloses canonical versus indexed coverage for the query.

freshness.description: freshness pins the served generation and discloses its state.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.AskSuccess.jsonsc.title: Ask Success

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CausalContext.jso.description: CausalContext binds messages to an ordered, fenced causal history.

causationId.description: causation_id names the immediate triggering event or command.

fence.description: fence prevents an expired lease holder from committing.

sequence.description: sequence is monotonically assigned by the canonical ledger.

traceId.description: trace_id identifies a separately authorized trace stream.

watermark.description: watermark records the complete source position observed by a projection.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CausalContext.jso.title: Causal Context

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.description: Digest identifies immutable bytes using a named digest algorithm.

algorithm.description: algorithm identifies the canonical digest algorithm, for example sha256.

hex.description: hex is the lower-case encoded digest value.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.title: Digest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.Co.description: CodeAnchor identifies an immutable Git tree and optional precise source range.

gitOid.description: git_oid identifies an immutable commit or tree.

range.description: range identifies the source span when available.

symbolId.description: symbol_id identifies a resolved code symbol when available.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.Co.title: Code Anchor

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceRef.jsons.description: EvidenceRef identifies evidence metadata and optionally one precise anchor.

anchorDigest.description: anchor_digest identifies an optional canonical anchor serialization.

evidenceId.description: evidence_id is an opaque evidence identity.

sourceRevisionId.description: source_revision_id identifies the immutable source revision.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceRef.jsons.title: Evidence Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.FactualConsistenc.description:
FactualConsistencyProvenance pins the implementation and calibration bytes
 behind one numeric factual-consistency result. It never identifies evidence.

calibrationDigest.description: calibration_digest binds the immutable calibration artifact bytes.

calibrationId.description: calibration_id identifies the declared calibration population and method.

scorerId.description: scorer_id is a stable implementation family, not a floating provider alias.

scorerVersion.description: scorer_version pins the exact scoring behavior.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.FactualConsistenc.title: Factual Consistency Provenance

evaluatedClaimCount.description: evaluated_claim_count is the number of fully evaluated claims.

provenance.description: provenance is required only for a scored result.

reason.description: reason is unspecified only for a scored result.
reason.title: Factual Consistency Reason

scorePerMille.description: score_per_mille is a calibrated [0, 1000] estimate when status is SCORED.

status.description: status distinguishes scored, answer abstention, and unknown outcomes.
status.title: Factual Consistency Status

totalClaimCount.description: total_claim_count is the bounded answer claim count presented to scoring.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.FactualConsistenc.title: Factual Consistency Score

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GitSnapshot.jsons.description: GitSnapshot is server-authored canonical metadata for one committed tree.

commitOid.description: commit_oid is the resolved local committed Git object ID.

policyDigest.description: policy_digest is authored after normalizing ignore and symlink policy.

snapshotId.description: snapshot_id names the immutable snapshot fact.

treeOid.description: tree_oid is the exact root tree resolved from commit_oid.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GitSnapshot.jsons.title: Git Snapshot

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GroundedAnswerCla.description: GroundedAnswerClaim is one bounded material answer assertion and its support.

authorityClass.description: authority_class is always AUTHORITY_CLASS_MODEL_PROPOSAL at this boundary.
authorityClass.title: Authority Class

citations.description: citations provide exact authorized support; unsupported claims are discarded.

claimId.description: claim_id is an opaque claim identity within one answer.

confidencePerMille.description: confidence_per_mille is a disclosed calibrated estimate in [0, 1000].

statement.description: statement is the bounded material assertion text.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GroundedAnswerCla.title: Grounded Answer Claim

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GroundedCitation..description: GroundedCitation binds one claim to exact authorized committed-code evidence.

anchor.description: anchor pins the exact committed Git object and line/column range.

evidence.description: evidence identifies the cited immutable evidence and source revision.

supportingTextDigest.description: supporting_text_digest binds the hydrated supporting bytes without prose.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GroundedCitation..title: Grounded Citation

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier

ouroboros.contracts.v1.IngestionGenerati.description: IngestionGeneration identifies one immutable source projection generation.

generationId.description: generation_id is the opaque immutable generation identity.

languageReadiness.description: language_readiness contains exactly one record for each P5 language.

sequence.description: sequence is monotonic within the source.

snapshot.description: snapshot pins the exact committed Git inputs.

sourceWatermark.description: source_watermark is the complete canonical source position observed.

state.description: state distinguishes unservable, ready, and degraded generations.
state.title: Generation State

ouroboros.contracts.v1.IngestionGenerati.title: Ingestion Generation

ouroboros.contracts.v1.LanguageReadiness.description: LanguageReadiness reports one P5 lane's syntax-aware or degraded state.

coverage.description: coverage distinguishes bounded syntax awareness from lexical degradation.
coverage.title: Coverage State

language.description: language identifies exactly one P5 language.
language.title: Code Language

reasonCode.description: reason_code is a stable non-sensitive explanation for degraded coverage.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.LanguageReadiness.title: Language Readiness

ouroboros.contracts.v1.PublicError.jsons.description: PublicError exposes a static public error code with an optional safe render model.

code.description: code is a stable, non-sensitive machine-readable public error code.

render.description: render supplies presentation-safe text for the TUI.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.PublicError.jsons.title: Public Error

ouroboros.contracts.v1.QueryAnswer.jsons.description: QueryAnswer is the bounded grounded result: answered, partial, or abstained.

claims.description: claims is the bounded complete material-claim set for the prose.

degradedReasons.description: degraded_reasons discloses partial or abstention causes from a bounded set.

factualConsistency.description: factual_consistency discloses a calibrated score or explicit non-score.

prose.description: prose is the rendered answer; every material span maps to a claim.

queryId.description: query_id echoes the server-authored admitted query identity.

status.description: status distinguishes answered, disclosed partial, and abstained results.
status.title: Answer Status

ouroboros.contracts.v1.QueryAnswer.jsons.title: Query Answer

ouroboros.contracts.v1.QueryCoverage.jso.description: QueryCoverage discloses canonical versus indexed coverage without existence detail.

canonicalRevisionCount.description: canonical_revision_count counts canonical revisions in the pinned generation.

indexedRevisionCount.description: indexed_revision_count counts revisions present in the search projection.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.QueryCoverage.jso.title: Query Coverage

ouroboros.contracts.v1.QueryFreshness.js.description: QueryFreshness pins one complete Stage 03 generation and discloses its state.

aclEpoch.description: acl_epoch records the authorization epoch used for hydration decisions.

generation.description: generation pins the exact served committed-Git generation and readiness.

observedAt.description: observed_at records when the freshness state was evaluated.

state.description: state discloses whether the pinned generation is current, stale, or degraded.
state.title: Freshness State

ouroboros.contracts.v1.QueryFreshness.js.title: Query Freshness

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Receipt.jsonschem.description: Receipt records the authoritative outcome of an admitted operation.

causal.description: causal binds the outcome to replayable ordering and fencing state.

configurationDigest.description: configuration_digest pins the effective configuration without secret plaintext.

evidence.description: evidence records immutable inputs and outputs supporting this outcome.

operationId.description: operation_id identifies the command, run, or effect being receipted.

reasonCode.description: reason_code is a non-sensitive stable reason, never an upstream error body.

receiptId.description: receipt_id is a globally unique opaque receipt identifier.

recordedAt.description: recorded_at is when the receipt became canonical.

status.description: status is a stable, machine-readable outcome.
status.title: Receipt Status

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Receipt.jsonschem.title: Receipt

ouroboros.contracts.v1.RenderModel.jsons.description: RenderModel is a bounded non-sensitive presentation model for the thin TUI.

actionLabel.description: action_label suggests the next local action without implying authority.

detail.description: detail is bounded static explanatory text and never an upstream error body.

title.description: title is a stable short heading suitable for a terminal status line.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.RenderModel.jsons.title: Render Model

ouroboros.contracts.v1.SourceRange.jsons.description: SourceRange identifies a source-code range using one-based line and column values.

endColumn.description: end_column is a one-based exclusive column number.

endLine.description: end_line is a one-based exclusive line number.

path.description: path is a repository-relative source path.

startColumn.description: start_column is a one-based inclusive column number.

startLine.description: start_line is a one-based inclusive line number.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.SourceRange.jsons.title: Source Range
